name: harness-session-resumed
notes: Sources/PhoneDSHAgentCore/AgentHarness.swift:147-163 (id, capabilities, last_seq); a session may narrow the backend's static set, never widen it (AgentHarness.swift:480-482). The DSH remote returns last_seq nil even when it resumes an existing session (DSHRemoteHarness.swift:86), so a host MUST keep its own processed-seq cursor and not treat last_seq as the resume cursor (plan §4.2).
